title: Proposition 10.4: unramified transformations between spectral pregeometries
statement_scope: Let TSp_disc, TSp_Zar and TSp_ét be the pregeometries of Remark VII.1.28, Definition VII.2.18 and Definition VII.8.26, respectively. Then the evident transformations TSp_disc→TSp_Zar, TSp_disc→TSp_ét and TSp_Zar→TSp_ét are unramified. Complete statement and proof retained.
